entities.summary: Yoseph Haddad is an Arab-Israeli journalist and activist who advocates for Israel on social media and international speaking tours. He is the founder of Together – Vouch for Each Other which works to integrate Arab Israelis into larger Israeli society. Since the beginning of the Gaza war, Haddad has become more widely known in Israel. He has been recognized by Israeli media and the Israeli Foreign Ministry for his pro-Israel advocacy.
